notes: Claude now runs the account itself: an Observe run before the open, a Decide run at 9:35 that trades, and a Monitor run at midday, each an unattended Claude session on the subscription that can only use the trader's own tools. Starts from a mildly aggressive swing-trading playbook (version 1). The status page shows Claude's notes from each run and what the day's runs would have cost at list price.
